title: Tidewater Beach
meta_description: Wake up to Gulf-front views at Beachfront Vista, a Tidewater Beach Resort condo with direct beach access, resort amenities, and walkable fun near Pier Park.
description_expanded:
Wake up to sweeping Gulf views and the calming sound of the waves at Beachfront Vista, a comfortable and thoughtfully designed condo located within the iconic Tidewater Beach Resort---one of the most sought-after beachfront destinations in Panama City Beach. Enjoy added ease during your stay with seasonal beach service, including 2 chairs and 1 umbrella set up daily from March 1 through October 20.

Set directly along the shoreline, this front-row location makes beach days effortless, whether you're heading out for a morning walk along the sand or settling in for a full afternoon by the water. Just a short walk away, Pier Park offers an energetic mix of restaurants, shopping, and entertainment, including favorites like Jimmy Buffett's Tootsies, Margaritaville, and seasonal live events.

Inside, the condo feels bright, clean, and inviting, designed for relaxed coastal living. The open living area leads to a private balcony where Gulf views frame slow mornings with coffee and easy evenings watching the sunset roll in.

The full kitchen is equipped with all the essentials, ideal for everything from beach-day snacks to casual dinners at home. Enjoy meals at the dining table for two or gather at the kitchen counter with seating for four. An in-unit washer and dryer add everyday convenience throughout your stay.

Sleeping accommodations are ideal for families or small groups. The primary bedroom features a king bed and an ensuite bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The second bedroom offers a twin-over-twin setup, while the living room includes a sleeper sofa---comfortably sleeping up to six guests. A second full bathroom with a walk-in shower ensures everyone has space to refresh.

As a guest of Tidewater Beach Resort, you'll enjoy access to an impressive lineup of resort-style amenities, including two expansive outdoor pools, an indoor heated pool, hot tubs, a fitness center with beach views, a movie theater, arcade, on-site dining, a lively tiki bar, and a convenience market serving Starbucks café drinks.

Whether you're here for sun-soaked beach days, resort-style relaxation, or walkable access to the best of Panama City Beach, Beachfront Vista delivers the views, amenities, and location to make your stay unforgettable.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

Panama City Beach is one of Florida's most welcoming coastal destinations, known for its 27 miles of sugar-white sand, emerald Gulf waters, and a vibrant mix of family-friendly attractions, waterfront dining, and outdoor adventure. Guests can spend their days exploring St. Andrews State Park, spotting dolphins on Shell Island excursions, savoring fresh seafood at local institutions like Schooners, or enjoying the lively entertainment and shopping at Pier Park. With its easygoing atmosphere, year-round sunshine, and endless blend of relaxation and recreation, PCB offers something for every type of traveler---from beach lovers and boaters to families, foodies, and groups looking to unwind by the water.

Local Attractions: Pier Park, Dolly Pirate Ship, Top Golf, Shipwreck Island Waterpark, Russell-Fields Pier, St. Andrews State Park, Thomas Drive, Shell Island, Conservation Park, WonderWorks, Ripley's Believe It or Not, Camp Helen State Park, Frank Brown Park, Panama City Beach Winery, Aaron Bessant Park, Laguna Beach.

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Beach service is included with your stay and features 2 chairs and 1 umbrella, set up daily from March 1 through October 20. Availability is seasonal and not offered outside of these dates.
- Elevator modernization is nearing completion, with several upgrades already finished. All elevators remain operational, though you may experience slightly longer wait times during peak hours.

Parking Details:
- Parking garage available (2 passes provided at the registration desk). Vehicles must not exceed 7'2" height.
- Additional costs include Tidewater parking pass and wristband fee. Wristbands are given to all guests 12 and up and must be worn at all times while on the property.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
